#include<bits/stdc++.h>

using namespace std;

long long xx = -1, yy, a, b, n;

void try_update(long long x, long long y) {
    if (xx == -1) {
        xx = x;
        yy = y;
        return;
    }
    long long lhs = llabs(a * y - b * x) * yy;
    long long rhs = llabs(a * yy - b * xx) * y;
    if (lhs < rhs) {
        xx = x;
        yy = y;
    }
}

int main() {
#ifndef ONLINE_JUDGE
    freopen("a.in", "r", stdin);
#endif
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld", &a, &b, &n);
    for (long long y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
        long long x = y * a / b;
        try_update(x, y);
        ++x;
        try_update(x, y);
    }
    printf("%lld/%lld\n", xx, yy);
    return 0;
}
